summary: Satya, co-host of Melanin Millennials, publicly announced their removal from the show and denial of co-creator rights by Shout Out Network (SON) CEO M.R.A.L. Morgan and founder Effie, revealing that SON owned the show's trademark without consent and replaced Satya with new hosts in August 2017. Satya stated they intended to reclaim ownership of the content they created while expressing deep regret that their mission to amplify Black British millennial voices was cut short without transparency or agency.
